nodes.label: Context Budget Is the Real Constraint
nodes.rationale: A subagent can read forty files and return twelve lines; the same reads inline are permanent and survive compaction. Rule: whoever holds the decision should not hold the evidence.

nodes.label: Five-Part Dispatch Brief
nodes.rationale: An agent inherits none of the conversation; a vague brief produces confident wrong code, and without an output cap a competent agent returns 400 lines into the one context that cannot afford it.

nodes.label: Parallel Only When File Sets Are Provably Disjoint
nodes.rationale: Ownership lists do not make parallel safe: two agents on separate production files both force an edit to the same test file or openapi regen, and the second write silently loses the first. Migration numbers collide the same way.

nodes.label: Verifying a Claim (JSON reporter gate)
nodes.rationale: PASS(0) FAIL(0) means failed-to-collect, positionals are filename filters, a killed background command exits 0, and grep masks matches as 'Binary file'. Green is only green from --reporter=json.

nodes.label: Tests That Cannot Fail
nodes.rationale: Bare {status:422}, symmetric fixtures, bare data-* probes ($undefined serialisation) and disabled: assertions all pass in both states; when a true red is impossible, substitute a hand mutation — and revert with cp, never git checkout.

nodes.label: The Standard Wave
nodes.rationale: inline plan -> scout -> implementer -> reviewer -> inline gate + commit -> memory. Step 5 is not delegable: the number reported to the user is the number you ran.

nodes.label: Agent Memory Durability
nodes.rationale: .claude/agent-memory is git-excluded on purpose, so it has no recovery path — an implementer's rm -rf lost 23 topic files in July 2026. Worktrees start with none and must symlink the shared directory.

edges.source_location: §3 / §6 — worktrees are the isolation answer and the memory-loss surface
